name: Syncopated electro stabs
desc: Punchy Bm7 stab machine cycling Bm7 - Gmaj7 - Dmaj7 - A7 through two alternating syncopation grids, saw-pump duck against the kick, crush biting alternate bars. Peak doubles attacks with ply and a detuned shadow. The chordal counterpuncher for glitch bass lines.

code.full: note("<[b2,d3,f#3,a3] [g2,b2,d3,f#3] [d3,f#3,a3,c#4] [a2,c#3,e3,g3]>").add(note(${root})).struct("<[x ~ x ~ ~ x ~ ~] [x ~ ~ x ~ x x ~]>").s("sawtooth").superimpose(x=>x.add(note(.07)).gain(.6)).crush("<16 10>").decay(.18).sustain(.25).release(.09).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.6, ${cut}).slow(16)).shape(.35).room(.22).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.68, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[b2,d3,f#3,a3] [g2,b2,d3,f#3] [d3,f#3,a3,c#4] [a2,c#3,e3,g3]>").add(note(${root})).struct("<[x ~ x x ~ x ~ x] [x x ~ x ~ x x ~]>").s("sawtooth").ply("<1 1 1 2>").superimpose(x=>x.add(note(.09))).crush("<10 6>").decay(.16).sustain(.25).release(.08).lpf(sine.range(${cut}*.7, ${cut}*1.3).slow(8)).shape(.4).room(.2).gain(saw.range(${gain}*.72, ${gain}).fast(4)).orbit(4).play()
